parent_objective: audit finite but directionally weak materialized source-history objective evaluator result
blocked_by: M1339 evaluator passes structurally but has both_directional_fraction=0.0 and must be classified before objective updates
supersedes: direct objective-only update on M1339 exact residual without result audit

public_gates: M1340 must not update actor weights
M1340 must not use private holdout
M1340 must preserve actor input contract
M1340 must classify the directionally weak M1339 result
M1340 must decide objective design versus evaluator/projection repair

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits finite M1339 exact objective metrics and classifies directionally weak signal before any objective update
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: process audit only; no promotion, private-holdout, PPO, actor-update, closed-loop, paper-level, high-fidelity, or strong self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if audit routes directly to actor update without classifying directional conflict
stop if audit treats finite objective as solved self-identification
stop if private holdout is used
fallback_plan: if weakness is directional conflict, route to pair/group objective design
if weakness is source-current projection artifact, repair evaluator projection
if weakness is corpus symmetry, route to source-pair/group audit
if objective is usable as-is, route to bounded no-PPO objective-update design
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1339 exact evaluator result has finite residual and zero both-directional fraction

admission_evidence: PPO and actor update remain blocked
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review
next_stage_criteria: next route is selected before objective update

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1340 audits source-current zero-context diagnostics and cannot claim closed-loop history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: audit correct-history versus wrong-history action likelihood and action-distance residuals from M1339
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: The zero both-directional result must be recorded and routed before any actor update.
allowed_claims: no strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, high-fidelity validation, real-vehicle, paper-result, or closed-loop driver claim

hypothesis: The finite but directionally weak M1339 evaluator result can be classified into a safe next route before any objective-only update.
success_criteria: audit cites row_count, finite counts, checkpoint immutability, and quarantine exclusion
audit cites exact objective and directional metrics
audit cites family and fold summaries
audit chooses objective design, pair/group audit, projection repair, or evaluator repair
no training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, threshold relaxation, actor update, or actor-input expansion occurs
failure_criteria: audit routes directly to PPO or actor update
training, PPO, private holdout, promotion, threshold relaxation, actor update, or actor-input expansion occurs
decision_rule: M1340 passes as a process audit if it classifies the finite but weak M1339 result and selects one safe next route before any objective update, PPO, private holdout, promotion, or actor-input expansion.
